crossRefs.note: “In that day there will be a spring opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for…
but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will…

translations.web: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, a spring or cistern containing water will remain clean, but one who touches a carcass in it will be unclean.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
translations.asv: Nevertheless a fountain or a pit wherein is a gathering of water shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcass shall be unclean.
